question: After the two correctness findings are fixed, should OpenClaw bundle a 1Password SecretRef provider that executes an operator-pinned external `op` binary with forwarded authentication environment?
rationale: Batching and alias handling are mechanical fixes, but accepting the bundled credential-execution boundary and runtime dependency requires maintainer/security intent.

options.title: Approve bundled integration
options.body: Land the opt-in plugin after the findings are fixed and security owners approve the external `op` contract.

options.title: Externalize the plugin
options.body: Publish the integration outside core while retaining the existing plugin-managed SecretRef APIs.

options.title: Pause for generic policy
options.body: Defer until a repository-wide policy for bundled external-CLI secret resolvers is defined.

recommendation.title: Approve bundled integration
recommendation.body: Land the opt-in plugin after the findings are fixed and security owners approve the external `op` contract.

likelyOwner.reason: He merged and hardened the sibling Vault SecretRef integration and is the strongest current-history match for this decision.
